entities.summary: Vilbrun Guillaume Sam, a notable figure in the history of Haiti, associated with United States Occupation of Haiti (1900–1915). Preceded by Pre-Occupation Political Crisis. Their legacy influenced U.S. Marines invade Haiti — July 28, 1915 and Charlemagne Péralte leads Caco resistance — killed November 1, 1919.
